keys.description: Budget keys (timeouts.adoc, Job Budgets): <build_system>:<verb>[@<module_id>] (a verb's template names its build profile literally, so the key carries none), git:<operation>, ci:<operation> (the contract operation name; one key for the native in-process operation and the CLI job alike), llm:<role> (workers, one key per role whatever the harness). project_script keys never learn.

learned_seconds.description: Blended baseline L; null before the first observation.

clean.description: Finished runs without residue or cold start: the baseline L used for allocation.

poisoned.description: Residue-poisoned runs; used only while clean.observations == 0.

cold.description: Cold rebuilds; used only while clean.observations == 0.

escalation_seconds.description: One-shot escalation budget E set by a timed_out run; cleared by the next finished run.
